page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. No marginal notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: alijsque sacris ordinibus institutis apud Imperatores diutius moras agere, decreto tamen Imperatoris hoc absque periculo fieri, & quod eis imperatur, exercebunt, vt neque Imperatori quicquam possit imputari, si eos accersat, neq; ij rei futuri sunt, vt qui iubenti Imperatori acquiescant. In Baptismo post cereum accensum exhibitum Baptizatis, sequebatur lactis, & mellis degustatio, quam olim vsitatam fuisse testatur Tertullianus de corona militis capite 3. Hieronymus citat aduersus Luciferianos. Verum hæc cerimonia in desuetudinem abijt. Vide plura apud Vasquez Disputatione 166. cap. 6. & Henriquez lib. 2, cap. 13. Canon Trullanus septuagesimus secundus præcipit, si ex infidelibus coniugibus alteruter fidem fuerit amplexus, & infideli cum fideli habitare placeat, non esse segregandos iuxta Pauli vocem. Sub Patriarcha tamen Theodosio buccinator quidam Imperatorius baptizatus, per scripturam Patriarchicam separatus est, quæ merito non obtemperabat multum roganti, vt religionem suam ampletteretur, id quod Canoni contrarium est, adnotat nescio quis in Harmenopuli Epitome Canon. fec.5. Tit. 2. Plura hic adderem, sed si cui hæc non sufficiunt, neque sexcenta alia suffece-rint.

page.notes: Page number printed at the top as "430" (the o is a small superscript form). No running head. The printed word "suffecerint" is split across the line end as "suffece-" / "rint." and is written whole with its printed hyphen. "Canon. fec.5." is copied as printed; the first letter looks like a long s, which is written plain as "s" by the rules, but I left the letters as seen because I cannot confirm them. The right edge of the scan shows only the page edge and no text, so no margin notes are recorded.
